prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Francium (Fr) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: the tidal causeway of her element's kingdom at low water — wet sand, a line of marker poles and the island town ahead
Time of day: early morning — low clean light, long soft shadows.
Outfit: a tide guide look fitted to her body — a cropped wrap top, short rolled shorts, a sea-blue scarf and bare feet on the wet sand, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: walking.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera slightly below, looking up at her; she is placed in the left third of the frame, open space of the place to her right.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left arm hangs relaxed at her side.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a tall marker pole with a little bell up beside her face; it is all she holds.
LEGS: mid-stride, one heel lifting.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: crinkled lower eyelids, closed-lip smile pushing the cheeks up, brows relaxed.
Scene note: she is the tide-crossing guide waving the way across before the sea comes back

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — francium: the last element ever discovered in nature, found in 1939 in Paris by a former laboratory assistant who traced a rare branch in the decay of actinium, and named for France; the youngest of the alkali metals after caesium and rubidium, so restless that its longest-lived form lasts only twenty-two minutes and only a few dozen grams exist in the whole Earth at any moment, so no one has ever seen a piece of it; it has shown itself only as a tiny glowing cloud of atoms caught where laser beams cross, and like its sisters it would flare and boil in water if it ever stayed long enough — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: toned athletic-curvy, full-busted with rounded hips — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
